subject: Ephemeral test-suite loan: exchange checklist and close timeline
messages:
From: Sam Park <sam.park@brightline.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short evaluation loan of your test-suite and promptpack

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Brightline Retail is interested in running a short hands-on evaluation of Redwood's inference characteristics on our typical retail prompts. To make a quick go/no-go decision we would like an ephemeral loan of: a) a representative test-suite (100–300 test cases) and b) the corresponding promptpack that demonstrates typical instruction/formatting that we use.

High-level asks:
- 2-week evaluation window (we can be flexible by a few days)
- Non-production sandbox only; no external sharing beyond two named Brightline engineers (copied)
- A short mutual action plan (MAP) with delivery / installation steps + destruction schedule

If you can send a suggested MAP and a sample promptpack (or a download link), we can route to procurement quickly. For context: our timeline is to complete the POC and procurement decision by April 8.

Attachments: none in this message.

Thanks,
Sam Park
Senior Product Manager, Brightline Retail
sam.park@brightline.ai

--
Elena Voss (cc) is our lead evaluation engineer — she will actually run the tests.

Subject: Re: Request: short evaluation loan of your test-suite and promptpack

Hi Sam — great to hear and thanks for the clear timeline.

We can support an ephemeral loan under a short MAP with explicit usage constraints. Draft details below (summary):

1) Delivery contents (what we provide)
- promptpack-sample-v2.zip (representative prompt templates + a small annotation guide) [Attachment: promptpack-sample-v2.zip]
- test-suite-sample.csv (100 curated cases, edge-case flags, and expected outputs)
- MAP-checklist-v1.xlsx (delivery checklist + takedown schedule) [Attachment: MAP-checklist-v1.xlsx]

2) Loan window and takedown
- Standard window: 14 days from provisioning; we can extend to 21 days by written approval (request via account team).
- At the end of the window Brightline must either: confirm deletion (signed takedown form) or request an extension. We will provide a short script for secure wipe of sandbox artifacts.

3) Usage constraints
- Allowed: internal evaluation, performance testing, and model comparison only.
- Not allowed: productizing Sunny Retail prompts, sharing outside the named evaluation team, or including in model training corpora.
- Data handling: do not upload Redwood-supplied test assets to third-party hosted datasets or public repos.

4) IP & confidentiality
- Redwood retains ownership of supplied evaluation assets; Brightline is granted a limited, non-transferable evaluation license limited to the loan window.
- If you require a mutual NDA before delivery, please attach it; otherwise we can exchange a one-page MAP and an MPA signature PDF.

5) Next steps and timeline
- If you confirm acceptance by EOD Wed (Mar 24) we can provision by end of day Thu (Mar 25).
- Please confirm the two named Brightline recipients and whether you want the 14 or 21 day window.

Attachments included: MAP-checklist-v1.xlsx, promptpack-sample-v2.zip (stubs)

Thanks — looping in Marissa (rev ops) and Karthik (security/compliance) to keep approvals fast.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks Soojin — that level of detail is perfect. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

- We prefer a 21-day window if Redwood is open to it (three weeks helps us run additional throughput scenarios).
- We will not share the assets externally; Elena and one backend engineer (Mohit Singh) will be the only people with access.
- Procurement asked whether we can include a clause about audit logs retention (we need a week of logging retained post-takedown for validation).

If you can confirm the 21-day option and the logs retention clause, we will attach a PO and aim to sign the MAP next week.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

—Sam

Team / Sam — quick note from ops: we are comfortable with a 21-day loan window for this MAP with the following firm conditions (please confirm in the signed MAP):

- Takedown: Brightline must run the Redwood-provided wipe script and return the signed takedown confirmation within 72 hours of window end.
- Audit logs: Redwood will retain one week of request/trace logs post-takedown for compliance verification; logs will be redacted to remove any Brightline PII and retained only for validation purposes.
- Extension process: any extension requests must be made at least 5 business days before the end of the original window and approved in writing by Redwood RevOps.
- Sandbox access: access credentials will be ephemeral tokens tied to the named evaluators; do not reuse tokens across teams.

Sam — if that aligns, please sign the attached MAP (signed-MAP-BL-2791.pdf) and confirm the final two recipients (Elena + Mohit Singh) and we will schedule provisioning for Thu, Mar 25.
